incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: routing anomalies detected — elevated 5xx + latency spikes for eu-west across tier=standard fallback path. Pager sent to @sre-oncall. Incident ID: INC-2026-0592

sre-oncall: got the page, looking. seeing 502s and delayed responses from fallback-model pool (r-fallback-2).

maya: visual is showing spillover from eu-west-primary -> eu-west-standby around 06:12 UTC, CPU on standby jumped.

ingrid: notified sales and CS that some customers in EU may have degraded inference latency. support-lead please?

support-lead: on it. opening high-priority ticket to affected customers, will post template.

sre-oncall: quick triage: routing logs show many requests mismatched to tier policy — requests with header X-Redwood-Tier:standard were routed to tier=high-quantized-fallback which is wrong. suspect routing table version mismatch.

dmitri: pulling router logs now. can you paste a sample key?

sre-oncall: snippet from proxy logs (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T06:12:03Z] req_id=abc123 user=acct-42 route=eu-west-primary -> fallback: model=rw-13b-q8, tier=high-quantized-fallback status=200 latency_ms=120
[2026-03-15T06:12:04Z] req_id=abc124 user=acct-42 route=eu-west-primary -> fallback: model=rw-13b-fp16, tier=standard-fallback status=502 latency_ms=1200 error='incompatible-kv-cache'
```

dmitri: aha — mixed model variants. The router is selecting fallback based on model compatibility table but the table version on the eu-west edge looks stale. new hint: kernel compatibility check failing for some quantized variants so it falls back to FP16 but doesn't update tier mapping.

ingrid: can we confirm when the compatibility table was last pushed to regions?

deploy-bot: rollout: compatibility-table v32 -> v33 deployed to control-plane 06:09:42 UTC

maya: rollout timeline shows v33 deployment started 06:09, but eu-west-edge agents last pulled v32 at 06:08 and failed to pick up v33 due to transient S3 503s.

sre-oncall: that matches. so some edges have v33, some still on v32 causing inconsistent routing logic -> misroutes and fallback to non-compatible model -> errors and latency.

support-lead: customer impact — preliminary list: 12 enterprise customers experienced >10% error rate in EU for ~22m window. I have CS notify draft ready.

cs-ops: adding note: impact window observed 06:09:42 -> 06:31:15 UTC. will attach logs.

sre-oncall: mitigation in-flight: rolling revert of compatibility-table to v32 globally, and pin routing to local model variants for 10m to prevent spillover. executing now.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: compatibility-table v33 -> v32 rollback started 06:19:05 UTC

dmitri: monitoring fallback-model pool health. kv-cache errors dropping off after partial rollback.

sre-oncall: can someone run a quick query to build an ordered timeline for RCA doc? I want events, deployments, edge pulls, customer errors.

ingrid: I'll take timeline. starting events:
- 06:08:30 UTC: control-plane v33 staged
- 06:09:42 UTC: v33 deployed to control-plane
- 06:10:05 UTC: eu-west-edge agents attempted pull; some returned 503 from S3
- 06:12:00 UTC: routing anomalies and 502s begin seen in proxy logs
- 06:19:05 UTC: rollback to v32 started
- 06:24:10 UTC: majority of edges reporting v32 after rollback
- 06:31:15 UTC: error rate returned to baseline

sre-oncall: good. attach raw query results when done. include sample req_ids for trace.

cs-ops: attaching sample req ids: abc124, abc125, abc130, abc178 (will paste via link)

support-lead: CS notify sent to affected accounts at 06:40 UTC (template: apology, impact window, mitigation steps, follow-up RCA by EOD).

dmitri: hypothesis tracking:
- H1: control-plane deploy v33 introduced routing/tier mapping changes requiring updated compatibility-table; some edges didn't get v33 due to transient S3 error -> inconsistent state -> misroutes.
- H2: v33 had a bug in model selection logic that caused fallback to incompatible model variants (less likely based on logs).
- H3: autoscaling on standby caused state mismatch under load -> KV cache incompatibility surfaced.

maya: evidence rank: H1 (strong), H3 (medium), H2 (low).

sre-oncall: next actions during incident: 1) finish rollback, 2) pin policies to local variant, 3) patch control-plane publish to use atomic manifest, 4) recreate deploy tests to simulate S3 transient. assigned: dmitri (3), maya (4), ingrid (timeline + RCA doc).

dmitri: will collect router diff between v32/v33 and dump selection logic:
```
# quick grep from compatibility table diffs
- model_group: rw-13b-q8 -> allowed_tiers: [high-quantized-fallback]
+ model_group: rw-13b-q8 -> allowed_tiers: [high-quantized-fallback, standard-fallback]  # v33 change
```

dmitri: that explains why some requests on v33 edges allowed broader fallbacks that mismatch KV cache.

ingrid: capturing this for RCA: change widened allowed fallbacks without ensuring kernel compatibility -> inconsistent behavior when some edges didn't get the updated compatibility map.

sre-oncall: paging handoff: @ingrid you'll take lead on RCA writeup. I'll continue monitoring for 1 hour then hand back to oncall shift for postmortem.

ingrid: acknowledged — will produce an in-incident RCA draft in /r/incidents/inc-2026-0592 by EOD with timeline, hypothesis table, logs, and recommended fixes.

cs-ops: adding note for SLO impact calc: will compute 5xx/tokens delta and attach to RCA.

support-lead: CS will schedule customer brief for tomorrow morning 09:00 CET.

sre-oncall: final note in thread: mitigation successful, rollback completed, traffic stable. will keep monitoring. please flag anything new. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 06:23:54 UTC (control-plane v32 enforced).

ingrid: thanks all — saving logs and links: 
- router traces: https://internal.redwood/traces/INC-2026-0592
- deploy timeline: https://internal.redwood/deploys/compat-table/v33
- customer impact list: https://internal.redwood/cs/incidents/INC-2026-0592/affected.csv

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall in 45m. please add any follow-ups to RCA doc.

cs-ops: confirming last_message_ts and closing temporal window in notes.

support-lead: closing slack notify after RCA published.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0592 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
